checkpoint_dir.description: Private directory for content-bound successful-operation checkpoints. Checkpoints survive a later rollback but are never reused automatically.

on_gene_failure.description: abort (default) refuses the whole batch and changes nothing. continue rolls each failing gene back to its own boundary and runs the remaining precomputed genes, producing a partial result: the report then sets batch_complete=false and lists every skipped gene in gene_failures[]. Never present such a run as a finished study, never treat a skipped gene as a negative biological finding, and report the failed genes and their reasons alongside the completed ones.

execution_timeout_secs.description: Approval-bound wrapper ceiling in seconds for the complete ordered multi-study batch. The 28800-second default allows long multi-gene Primer3 runs; review and override it from the combined plans rather than multiplying a hidden per-gene constant.

confirmation.reason: The approval binds every ordered plan/workflow file hash and operation digest; GENtle prevalidates the complete set before the first operation and executes it through one state-bound command.
